$comment: D4 local-only guards (M5). Data for scripts/ci/check-no-retailer.mjs (story M5.15). The check fails when any of these hosts appears in the Pages build output (apps/web/dist) or in a git-tracked file outside allowPaths, when a tracked file matches denyFiles, or when a tracked file is under denyDirs. Hosts match case-insensitively as a hostname suffix (www.ikea.com matches ikea.com) and as a plain substring of text files. Retailer data and models are streamed through the local server only (or read from the gitignored local catalogue under apps/server/local-assets, built by pnpm catalog:build), never committed or served from Pages. denyDirs also apply to the built dist; denyContent is a marker string (the local catalogue file format) that must appear in no dist file and no tracked file outside allowPaths.
